title: UNIVEST FINANCIAL Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Univest Financial Corporation filed an 8-K Current Report disclosing the results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on April 23, 2026. Shareholders voted on the election of four Class III Directors, ratification of KPMG LLP as independent auditor for 2026, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. All matters passed with substantial majority support.
key_points: Four Class III Directors (Joseph P. Beebe, Natalye Paquin, Anne Vazquez, Robert C. Wonderling) elected for three-year terms expiring in 2029
KPMG LLP ratified as independent registered public accounting firm for 2026 with 23,884,852 votes for, 466,638 against
Advisory vote on named executive officer compensation approved with 21,929,235 votes for, 561,000 against
Record date: April 23, 2026; 28,083,533 shares entitled to vote
Brian J. Richardson signed as Senior Executive Vice President and CFO on April 24, 2026
